claims.evidence: No brand, model, or part number markings are legible on the casing; witness could only classify by type, not by make/model.

claims.claim: Direct America (imported used, 'tokunbo' style) drive gearbox
claims.evidence: Origin/import history is not visible in any photo; only a generic yard setting is shown.
Witness explicitly notes it is unknown whether the unit starts or runs, and no test clip or gauge reading is shown.

risks.risk: Unit may not run or may have internal engine/transmission failure (the reason it was pulled is unknown).
risks.proof: Video of cold start and idle, plus a gear-engagement test on the transmission.

risks.risk: Claimed GMC Sierra V8 2008-2015 fitment cannot be confirmed; could be mismatched or generic.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of casting numbers, VIN tag, or OEM part number stamped on block/transmission.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified generic engine/transmission, not as confirmed GMC fitment part

risks.risk: Hidden cracks, corrosion, or fluid leaks on sides/underside not visible from this angle.
risks.proof: Additional photos from both sides, underside, and oil pan area, plus a close-up of any fluid residue.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible leak/damage, i.e. worst case

risks.risk: Missing accessories/sensors (ECU, mounts, sensors) that affect completeness and installation cost.
risks.proof: Full inventory photo of all included loose parts, harness ends, and sensors laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete unit requiring extra parts

risks.risk: Accident or fire damage history that could compromise block/transmission integrity.
risks.proof: Wide shot of the donor vehicle or wreck (if available) and close-ups of mounting points for impact signs.
risks.if_unproven: priced as accident-origin unit, worst case

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any stamped part numbers, casting marks, or VIN sticker on the engine block and transmission case
Video of the engine attempting to start and run, with sound
Photos from additional angles: both sides, underside, and rear of transmission
Photo of all included accessories (sensors, mounts, ECU, wiring harness ends) laid out
Any documentation or photo of the source vehicle it was pulled from
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a used engine-transmission assembly of unverified make/model and untested condition, so it can be priced at the worst-case generic/non-running tier while the seller's GMC-specific and performance claims remain unverifiable remotely.
